This is the setting that I play. The flow of the G major and A major work well with this classic Duncan tune.

↳ Posted by LastPosted on December 8th, 2015.

Ramnee Ceilidh, X:8

Just some adjustments to the tune to make it sound more like the original. Long live Brian Finnegan and Flook! I know they disbanded, but hey, they live on in their music and in the spirit of beautiful, cracking’ tunes.
